continuous_read_v3: [dry] Our auction budget? A vibe. So we ran the numbers. Sale price, one-point-two. Land price? The vibe. [amused] Twenty-four percent. Sweet as. Then the builder's real rate. Margin goes red. Ouch. Queue Ess Mee works backwards: to keep twenty percent, the most we can pay for the land is nine-seventeen. The walk-away number. Next morning, note's on the paddle. Going once. Paddle stays down. Lost the auction, kept the margin. Bid with a number, not a feeling. Small print: not financial advice. Run your numbers before the room does. Sign up at Queue Ess Mee dot Co dot N Z.
